title: H-Bridge
description: Drives one channel of an H-bridge (motor driver): follows an input in percent, or brakes or coasts the motor, as the action says.
activation: Runs every pass while enabled; commands the bridge only when the value or the action changes.

drive.title: Drive
drive.description: Speed and direction in percent: -100 to 100 for a full bridge (the sign is the direction), 0 to 100 for a half bridge. Overrides the Drive setting. Used when the action is Drive.
